newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMGEN INC CUT TO NEUTRAL.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMGEN INC CUT TO NEUTRAL.

text.p: Vector Securities International Inc analysts Barbara Hoffman and Michael King said Tuesday they downgraded Amgen Inc to neutral from attractive.

-- They also cut the earnings forecast to $2.75 from $2.83 for fiscal year 1997, with third- and fourth-quarter earnings each now estimated at $0.69 per share, down from prior estimates of $0.71 and $0.75, respectively.
-- The moves were sparked by Amgen's comments Tuesday that warned of reduced earnings expectations for its Epogen drug stemming from slowing, uncertain revenue growth, they said.

-- "Despite the pullback in AMGN shares, we think there is room for additioanl downside and not much likelihood of near term upside," the analysts wrote in a research note. "Therefore, we prefer to remain on the sidelines for the time being and rate the stock neutral."
